subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Avoid
solution:
The correct answer is: **Evade**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Avoid"** means to keep away from or stop oneself from doing something. (बचना)
 
 
• **Example:** She tried to avoid talking about the sensitive topic.
 
 
 
• **"Evade"** means to escape or avoid something, especially by cleverness or trickery. (टालना)
 
 
• **Example:** He managed to evade the difficult question during the interview.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **"Avoid"** is **"Evade."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Evade**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pursue** (पीछा करना): To follow or chase something or someone.
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to pursue a career in medicine.
 
 
 
• **Reflect** (प्रतिबिंबित करना): To think deeply or carefully about something.
 
 
• **Example:** She took some time to reflect on her choices.
 
 
 
• **Accept** (स्वीकार करना): To agree to take or receive something.
 
 
• **Example:** He was happy to accept the job offer.
 
 

Question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word "Avoid".

Correct Answer: **Evade**.
